EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Lead.FirstName},
Memphis Invest is pioneering the turnkey, passive real estate market. With almost 5,000 properties under management in 5 different markets, we are committed to building your portfolio the RIGHT way.
At Memphis Invest, we work closely with you to provide an exceptional experience and are dedicated to building long-term wealth through passive investments.
At this point, I have tried reaching out to you a couple times but I know your time is valuable...
If you are serious about building your passive real estate portfolio, simply click here, to schedule a one on one call with me.
If I don't hear from you, do I have your permission to close your file?
Either way, I look forward to hearing from you!
Take care,
Joshua
Take care,
